sections.title: What data we process
sections.body: To use DocePreço, we process the data you provide and register:
bullets: Account data: bakery name, email and phone.
App usage data: ingredients, recipes, sales, orders, customers and inventory you record.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: We use this data only to operate the service:
bullets: Authenticate your access and protect your account.
Calculate costs, margins and prices for your recipes and generate reports.
Send important communications related to the service.

sections.title: Sharing and security
sections.body: Your data is stored on secure servers. We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except when required by law or by providers that operate the app under confidentiality agreements.

sections.title: Your rights (LGPD)
sections.body: Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD – Law 13,709/2018), you may at any time:
bullets: Access, correct and update your data.
Request deletion of your personal data.
Revoke this consent within the app.
